newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes to resume Michigan service.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes to resume Michigan service.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said it will resume service Wednesday, operating as United Express, between Chicago's O'Hare Airport and Pellston, Mich.
Flights will be made between the two cities by a 19-passenger Beechcraft 1900D, the small airline said.
"Great Lakes' fleet of Beechcraft 1900D model airplanes has an average age of less than two years," it said.

Great Lakes voluntarily suspended all flights May 16 after U.S. Federal Aviation Administration inspectors found it operated "unairworthy aircraft." The airline operates as United Express in the Midwest, as Midway Connection in the Southeast and as Great Lakes Airlines in the Southwest.
"The airline expects to gradually resume service as the FAA completes its inspections of the airline's fleet," Great Lakes said.
United Express provides commuter service in affiliation with UAL Corp.
